games.headline: Stroud and Proud escapes Oops in a 1.1-point thriller
article: Stroud and Proud beat Oops 116.50 to 115.40 in Week 6, a nail-biter decided by 1.10 points. It doesn't get much closer than that.

Stroud and Proud put up 116.50 this week, 8.0 over their projected 108.5 and the 3rd-highest score of the week. Tyler Shough carried them with 32.2 points, about a quarter of the team's total, 12.5 over his projection. Kyle Pitts Sr. (20.5) and Jaxon Smith-Njigba (19.4) were the other big contributors.

Oops put up 115.40 this week, 7.7 over their projected 107.7. Drake Maye led the way with 30.4, and Malik Nabers added 22.5. That would have beaten most teams this week. Oops just ran into Stroud and Proud.
The letdown for Stroud and Proud was Emanuel Wilson, who managed 5.2 on a 14.1 projection.
Here's the painful part for Oops: starting Romeo Doubs (11.7) instead of Rome Odunze (5.4) would have produced 121.70 points, enough to win.
Stroud and Proud improves to 4-2 (3rd place), winners of 3 straight. Oops drops to 3-3 (6th).
Next week, Stroud and Proud faces * Go Buckeyes (1-5), who are coming off a 33.8-point loss to I Call Gibbs and have lost 3 straight.
Next week, Oops faces The Canberra Mob (2-4), who are coming off a 15.9-point win over Dena's Team 🏈. Oops will be without Jaguars D/ST (bye), so the bench is about to get some work.

games.headline: Slim Shiesties stuns Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup on Monday night
article: Slim Shiesties beat Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup 104.90 to 95.60 in Week 6, a close one decided by 9.30 points.

Slim Shiesties put up 104.90 this week, 8.3 under their projected 113.2. James Cook III carried them with 22.8 points, 4.1 over his projection. D'Andre Swift (21.0) and Broncos D/ST (11.0) were the other big contributors.

Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup managed 95.60 this week, 7.6 under their projected 103.2. Jonathan Taylor led the way with 20.1, and Chuba Hubbard added 18.6. That would have beaten most teams this week. Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup just ran into Slim Shiesties.
The letdown for Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup was Dak Prescott, who managed 12.7 on a 19.9 projection.
The letdown for Slim Shiesties was Jacoby Brissett, who managed 6.2 on a 18.4 projection.
At quarterback, Dak Prescott (12.7) outdueled Jacoby Brissett (6.2).
Going into Monday night, Slim Shiesties trailed by 1.60 and needed a big night. Mike Evans (10.9) delivered.
Slim Shiesties improves to 4-2 (4th place). Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup drops to 1-5 (11th) and has now lost 4 in a row.

Next week, Slim Shiesties faces K9 Unit (5-1), who are coming off a 40.4-point win over King Henry and have won 4 straight. Slim Shiesties will be without James Cook III, Parker Washington and Cam Little (bye), so expect some waiver-wire shopping.

Next week, Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup faces Dena's Team 🏈 (2-4), who are coming off a 15.9-point loss to The Canberra Mob. Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup will be without Khalil Shakir, Ladd McConkey and Cameron Dicker (bye), so expect some waiver-wire shopping.

Dena's Team 🏈 managed 74.20 this week, 28.3 under their projected 102.5 and the 3rd-lowest score of the week. Brock Purdy led the way with 18.8, and Hunter Henry added 12.8.
The letdown for Dena's Team 🏈 was Brandon Aubrey, who managed 1.0 on a 9.4 projection.
The letdown for The Canberra Mob was Harold Fannin Jr., who managed 1.4 on a 8.2 projection.
Not much Dena's Team 🏈 could have done about this one: even their best possible lineup (75.70) wouldn't have caught The Canberra Mob.

Next week, Dena's Team 🏈 faces Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup (1-5), who are coming off a 9.3-point loss to Slim Shiesties and have lost 4 straight.

games.headline: K9 Unit routs King Henry

King Henry managed 86.90 this week, 27.0 under their projected 113.9. Bhayshul Tuten led the way with 22.7, and Jalen Coker added 12.7.
The letdown for King Henry was Jameis Winston, who managed 8.4 on a 21.7 projection.
The letdown for K9 Unit was Bijan Robinson, who managed 6.3 on a 21.5 projection.

games.headline: Ken rallies past The Dude Abides on Monday night
article: Ken beat The Dude Abides 126.70 to 69.60 in Week 6, a beatdown decided by 57.10 points. This one was over early.

Ken put up 126.70 this week, 19.0 over their projected 107.7 and the 2nd-highest score of the week. Christian McCaffrey carried them with 26.2 points, 6.9 over his projection. Jayden Daniels (25.0) and DeVonta Smith (17.0) were the other big contributors.
The Dude Abides managed 69.60 this week, 50.7 under their projected 120.3 and the 2nd-lowest score of the week. Kirk Cousins led the way with 23.0.
The letdown for The Dude Abides was Kyren Williams, who managed 8.2 on a 19.3 projection.
Not much The Dude Abides could have done about this one: even their best possible lineup (111.60) wouldn't have caught Ken.
Ken could have scored even more by starting Trevor Lawrence (35.1) instead of Jayden Daniels (25.0) and Keon Coleman (13.9) instead of Xavier Worthy (10.8).

Going into Monday night, Ken trailed by 6.30 and needed a big night. Jayden Daniels (25.0), Christian McCaffrey (26.2) and George Kittle (15.4) delivered, while The Dude Abides got just 3.2 from Terry McLaurin.
Ken improves to 2-4 (8th place). The Dude Abides drops to 3-3 (7th).
Next week, Ken faces King Henry (3-3), who are coming off a 40.4-point loss to K9 Unit. Ken will be without Jayden Daniels (bye), so expect some waiver-wire shopping.

Next week, The Dude Abides faces I Call Gibbs (6-0), who are coming off a 33.8-point win over * Go Buckeyes and have won 6 straight. The Dude Abides will be without Terry McLaurin (bye), so expect some waiver-wire shopping.
